title: ComfortLease Outage Credit Schedule
content:
**Service desk schedule — ComfortLease Equipment Leases**

When the leased system is out of service, the outage credit is earned only for full days beyond 24 elapsed hours after the lessee reported it, at the system's outage credit per day, up to the system's monthly outage credit cap in one rent month, and it is posted as a service outage credit on the next rent month.

## Rates by system

| Leased system | Hours after the report before credit is earned | Credit per full day beyond that | Most credit earned in one rent month |
|---|---|---|---|
| ComfortLease Gas Furnace | 24 | $10.00 | $64.95 |
| ComfortLease Central Air | 24 | $10.00 | $79.95 |
| ComfortLease Heat Pump | 24 | $15.00 | $99.95 |
| ComfortLease Furnace & Central Air | 24 | $15.00 | $129.95 |
| ComfortLease Dual-Fuel System | 24 | $20.00 | $159.95 |
| ComfortLease Ductless Multi-Zone | 24 | $15.00 | $149.95 |

## Measuring an outage

- **The period.** One reported outage runs from the lessee's report to restoration. The record of it is the lessee's service call: the report is the moment the call was booked, and restoration is the completion of that call. The credit is reckoned from that service call record, for that service call.
- **Full days.** The first 24 elapsed hours earn nothing. Of the time beyond those 24 hours, only complete 24-hour days count; a part day does not.
- **The credit.** The credit is the number of full days multiplied by the system's credit per day, or the system's monthly cap if that is lower.
- **Posting.** The credit posts as a service outage credit on the next rent month and reduces what the lessee owes.

## Elapsed time to full days (hypothetical outages)

| Hypothetical hours from report to restoration | Hours beyond the first 24 | Full days credited |
|---|---|---|
| 23 | 0 | 0 |
| 47 | 23 | 0 |
| 48 | 24 | 1 |
| 70 | 46 | 1 |
| 72 | 48 | 2 |
| 130 | 106 | 4 |

## Worked credits (hypothetical outages)

- **ComfortLease Heat Pump, 72 hours:** 2 full days multiplied by $15.00 is $30.00, below the $99.95 cap; the credit is $30.00.
- **ComfortLease Dual-Fuel System, 130 hours:** 4 full days multiplied by $20.00 is $80.00, below the $159.95 cap; the credit is $80.00.
- **ComfortLease Gas Furnace, 200 hours:** 176 hours beyond the first 24 make 7 full days; 7 multiplied by $10.00 is $70.00, which exceeds the $64.95 cap, so the credit is $64.95.
- **ComfortLease Central Air, 47 hours:** no full day beyond the first 24 hours; no credit is earned.
